leah-ml: Quick check — after PR #432 landed, embeddings ingest seems to be dropping empty-string items from batch responses. Can someone confirm intended contract? cc @dina.dev @ryan-sre

ryan-sre: I hit this in prod search-ingest: input batch of 3 returned only 2 vectors, order got messed up. Logs show we filtered out items with len==0.

dina.dev: That shouldn't happen. Our contract has always been 1:1 mapping between inputs and embeddings array. We used to return a zero-vector for empty strings. Dropping is a breaking change.

sam-platform: Which endpoint exactly? /v1/embeddings (POST) with JSON {"input": [...] }? Example payload pls.

leah-ml: Example payload I used:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-small",
  "input": ["hello", "", "world"]
}
```

kevin-eng: This is on me — PR #432 added an early filter in the tokenization path to skip empty inputs to avoid useless model runs. I didn't consider the response mapping.

dina.dev: Skipping is not compatible. Options: return null placeholders, return zero-vectors, or return an error. Historically we returned numeric zero-vector so typed clients don't have to handle nulls.

ryan-sre: Also need to check batching logic: if we convert empty to zero-vector we should still count it as an item so batch size heuristics don't under- or over-run capacity.

sam-platform: Contract reminder: embeddings response must preserve ordering and length. Truncation behavior: items exceeding token limit are truncated per-model (we annotate per-item in metadata). For empty strings token length=0 -> no truncation.

kevin-eng: Plan: revert the early filter, add explicit mapping from input index -> output vector so empty inputs get a synthetic zero-vector and position is preserved. I'll add unit + integration tests. Will open a fix PR today and tag @dina.dev for review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for runtime patch kevin-eng/embeds-empty-fix at 2025-04-01T15:00Z :hammer_and_wrench:

leah-ml: :thumbsup: please include regression test with mix: ["", null, "a"]. Expect embeddings.length == inputs.length and empty/ null -> zero-vector of correct dim. Also test that truncation flags exist for trimmed items.

dina.dev: Prefer numeric zero-vector over null to maintain typed arrays across SDKs. Also add docs note about per-item metadata: "truncated": true/false, and "original_length": n_tokens.

kevin-eng: ack. I'll include per-item metadata in the response envelope (non-nested top-level arrays where possible) and add a changelog entry referencing backward-compat guarantees.

sam-platform: One more ask — confirm model dims for redwood-embed-small (currently 768) so tests assert vector shape [768].

kevin-eng: Confirmed 768 dims for that model.

leah-ml: I'll file the docs PR (789) and ping SDK teams to note the zero-vector behavior. ETA: EOD today for tests + docs draft.

dina.dev: Thanks everyone. After fix lands, let's run a small canary ingestion against search pipeline to validate ordering and latency impact.

kevin-eng: Will do. Thanks for the quick triage.
